verdict.rationale: Unleash documents 15 official client and server SDKs, and its docs distinguish backend SDKs (backend tokens) from client-side SDKs (frontend tokens safe to expose), which covers backend and web integration. The evidence never names mobile SDKs or shows that flag evaluation behaves the same across SDKs. missing for 10: explicit evidence of official mobile SDKs, documentation or corroboration of consistent flag evaluation across SDKs, independent hands-on validation.
